name: full-gates-web
description: The TypeScript/web full gate: one check command runs lint, typecheck, unit tests, build and end-to-end tests. The project adds its dependency audit and coverage floor to the command.

config.command: if [ -f package-lock.json ]; then npm ci --no-audit --no-fund; else npm install --no-audit --no-fund; fi && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build --if-present && npm run test:e2e --if-present
